subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series and complete the pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29b5859bb1c2d1c73ff1a059091e077d873a6a2c626efa93125313315acbcfa8.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) First box series → 

Alternately the elements are the corners of the 1st row and center element shift anticlockwise.

Alternately the elements are the corners of the 3rd row interchange positions.

2) Second box series → 

Alternately the elements are the corners of the 3rd row and center element shift clockwise.

Alternately the elements are the corners of the 1st row interchange positions.

3) The start element → Shift anticlockwise

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/459d82257441e288acb8af9a01b898af5dcb6fc3f432a5cd112977b38c855fd9.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/900064484a31cd6a75b1a268cc27e05a1e8910e5cb26a87dc8675ede8d4636aa.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
